identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Install CSM, Guardian, and kernel as one atomic generation

values.task_boundary: Implement only atomic matched-generation installation and pre-mutation verification for CSM, Guardian, and kernel.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: One command stages and validates all three binaries
AC-2: One receipt binds revision, platform, profile, Runtime-init schema, and three SHA-256 hashes
AC-3: Activation atomically changes one current reference
AC-4: Prior complete generation remains rollback-capable
AC-5: launchd and Runtime-init resolve the same generation
AC-6: start and reload reject invalid generations before service mutation
AC-7: Negative proof shows rejection leaves service untouched
AC-8: Matched activation and rollback tests pass
AC-9: Excluded Runtime and cloud behavior remains unchanged
AC-10: Focused validation, hygiene, and exact-head review pass
non_goals: Observatory, Caddy, cloud, Runtime v2, or live Runtime changes
